texts.text: The Many Diverse Applications of Access Solutions
Dive into the world of access solutions and discover some of the unexpected places where these elements are in use.
Positioning technology, such as hinges and display mounts
Electronic access solutions, such as latches, bolts, swing handles, and wireless and electronic controllers
Quick fasteners, such as pins or captive screws
Control elements, including clamping knobs and levers, handles, and levelling feet, as well as indexing elements
Through our brand partners, we offer innovative solutions that meet highest quality and design standards.
Quick Release FastenersCamloc®Quick fasteners and latches for machine parts and accessories that need to be opened and closed regularly.
Quick fasteners and latches for machine parts and accessories that need to be opened and closed regularly.
Gas Springs and Damper SolutionsCamloc Motion ControlGas springs, struts and dampers for safely lifting, positioning, lowering, and counterbalancing weights.
Gas springs, struts and dampers for safely lifting, positioning, lowering, and counterbalancing weights.
SNAP TechnologyDIRAK®High-strength connections without the need for tools. Large portfolio of hinges, latches, quarter turns, gaskets and more.
High-strength connections without the need for tools. Large portfolio of hinges, latches, quarter turns, gaskets and more.
Rod EndsDURBAL®Threaded rod ends with integrated spherical plain bearings. High-performance and maintenance-free.
Threaded rod ends with integrated spherical plain bearings. High-performance and maintenance-free.
Standard Machine ElementsElesa®Standard operating elements, handwheels and handles, clamping knobs, clamping levers, and levelling elements.
Standard operating elements, handwheels and handles, clamping knobs, clamping levers, and levelling elements.
Quick FastenersHalder®Spring plungers, ball-ended thrust screws, ball lock pins and threaded lifting pins for quick and easy connections.
Spring plungers, ball-ended thrust screws, ball lock pins and threaded lifting pins for quick and easy connections.
Standard and custom-made hinges, latches and locks, including continuous hinges, concealed hinges, positioning hinges and heavy-duty hinges.
A broad portfolio of access and control elements, including hinges, latches, locks, handles, captive screws, and electronic access solutions
Tolerance Compensation FastenersWITOL®Precise compensation of manufacturing tolerances while creating a solid, tension-free connection.
Precise compensation of manufacturing tolerances while creating a solid, tension-free connection.
The products listed here may not be available in all countries. In case of questions, please contact us.
